scope: Bounded differential reviews of apollo-main AmbiqSuite HAL modules (PWRCTRL, MSPI) against verbatim AmbiqSuite SDK 5.0.0 sources, which now replace the generated 5.1.0 copies and their hand variants in g2-apollo-main. Not workflow coverage, not hardware proof, not byte identity.

upstream.revision: release_sdk5p0p0-5f68a8286b (the revision the bootloader PWRCTRL matched, bootloader-hal-upstream-review.json)

identification: Function layout matches the bootloader's 5.0.0 block in source order with equal sizes: am_get_pwrctrl 32, TrimVersionGet 60, mcu_hp_lp_switch_sequence 300, mcu_mode_select 104, gpu_mode_select 232, mcu_memory_config 450, rom_enable/disable 82/82, sram_config 260, crypto_quiesce 74, periph_enable 314, msk_check 188, periph_disable 350, periph_enabled 72, INFO1_populate 404, low_power_init 810, buck_ldo_override_init 90, buck_ldo_update_override 52, control 292, cpdlp_get 32, temp_update 48, syspll_enable/disable 70/70.

apollo-main keeps am_hal_pwrctrl_gpu_mode_status (0x47f108, 20 B) and am_hal_pwrctrl_pwrmodctl_cpdlp_config (0x47ffc4) and drops am_hal_pwrctrl_settings_restore; the bootloader linked the opposite subset. Both are dead-code elimination of the same source.

Every bl/b.w call site in the 24 paired functions targets the same callee in both images (36 callee pairs, e.g. 0x480312 = bootloader 0x41cd1a am_hal_spotmgr_power_state_update, 0x4807a0 = 0x41d1c0 am_hal_delay_us, 0x4c44bc = 0x4222f0 am_hal_clkmgr_clock_request).

Stock RAM cells from the literal pools: g_ui32TrimVer 0x200001e8, g_DefaultMcuMemCfg 0x200001ec, g_eCurMcuPwrMode 0x20004538, g_sINFO1regs 0x20071948, g_orig_* 0x2007426c..0x200742ab (16 words, declaration order), g_ui8TRCENAcount 0x20074f5e, g_eCurGpuPwrMode/g_ePreGpuPwrMode/g_eCurROMPwrMode/g_bOrigTrimsStored 0x20074f60..0x20074f63.

build.profile: g2-apollo-main-108: g2-apollo-main-76 flags (hard-float, -Oz, -fno-inline, -mcpu=cortex-m55+nomve like every apollo-main profile) with the SDK 5.0.0 include tree and -mno-global-merge (keeps one data section per global so the stock cells can be pinned). Before +nomve the SLP vectorizer emitted MVE vldrw/vstrw in pwrctrl_INFO1_populate; stock has none.
build.payload: g2-apollo-main 2863/2863 compiled, 0 duplicate strong symbols, 24 unresolved (the same 24 names as build/full-g2-1029 before the swap)
build.note: The +nomve object links to the same .text bytes as the object the harness ran on.

replaced_hand_copies: the 27 replacements of the generated 5.1.0 am_hal_pwrctrl.c ({gen}/ambiqhal-apollo510/am_hal_pwrctrl.c and its sources.json generated entry)
the duplicate RAM cell audio_ble_flash_mode (.g2_ram_20074f62) in ble/ble-codec/ble_codec_byte_cells.c; the cell is g_eCurROMPwrMode

method.harness: build/main-pwr/diff_main_pwrctrl.py (ignored): reuses build/boot-hal-diff/diff_pwrctrl.py case generation, stubs and comparison on the IT-safe Unicorn base diff_queue.py.
method.new_side: The manifest object linked standalone (build/main-pwr/t.ld): text at 0x7a0000, every global at its stock cell, callees --defsym'd to their stock addresses, plus a test-only am_hal_interrupt_master_set (stock inlines it). The linked text is identical to the -mno-global-merge object first tested.
method.both_sides: Run inside the same stock image. SPOTMGR wrappers, clock manager, delay and status polls, INFO1 read, debug trace disable and clock-mux reset are stubbed at their stock addresses; am_hal_interrupt_master_disable 0x473940 runs natively on both sides. Each step compares return value, every MMIO write in order, every stubbed call with arguments, the pinned RAM cells, the out-buffer and the PRIMASK trace.
method.direct_calls: The 18 public functions. The six upstream statics (am_get_pwrctrl, TrimVersionGet, crypto_quiesce, pwrctrl_periph_disable_msk_check, pwrctrl_INFO1_populate, mcu_hp_lp_switch_sequence) are exercised through their callers only: clang specialises them (IPSCCP folds TrimVersionGet's pointer to &g_ui32TrimVer, unused returns are dropped), so a direct call is not the stock ABI.
harness_fixes: The per-step PRIMASK trace was one list shared by all steps of a case, so a later divergence showed up at step 0; each step now gets its own list (also in the bootloader harness).

Half the peripheral arguments now come from the specially handled ones (GFX 20, CRYPTO 23, DEBUG 28, OTP 29, PDM0 30, last 33, MAX 34); before, the GFX clock-request path was too rare for a mutant there to be caught.

main_pwrctrl.note: faults are NULL-pointer arguments that both sides dereference identically (sram_config, mcu_memory_config, temp_update, cpdlp_get)

bootloader_pwrctrl_rerun.note: re-run with the per-step trace and peripheral bias above

limitations: Synthetic MMIO and RAM only; no hardware run, and apollo-main still has no linked image.
Callees outside PWRCTRL are stubbed identically on both sides; apollo-main's SPOTMGR, clock manager and delay reconstructions are not covered here.
The eleven write-only g_orig_* statics are dropped by clang (stock keeps their stores at 0x20074280..0x200742ab); nothing reads them. Their cells differ in 80 of 1500 cases.
am_hal_pwrctrl_settings_restore, the *_get/_status functions and status_get are not linked in stock main and are not compared.

Nothing pins the PWRCTRL globals to their stock cells yet (g2-apollo-main.ld has no RAM map for them); the compose aliases g2_pwrctrl_trim_version, g2_pwrctrl_info1_regs and g2_pwrctrl_cur_mcu_mode_20004538 already name the upstream globals.

upstream.revision: release_sdk5p0p0-5f68a8286b (SDK 5.0.0 RTM, the bootloader MSPI revision)

identification: A normalised disassembly (branch targets and pc-relative literal offsets masked) of all 27 stock MSPI functions the bootloader also links is identical instruction for instruction to the bootloader's verified 5.0.0 RTM block (e.g. am_hal_mspi_control 1627/1627, mspi_device_configure 685/685, am_hal_mspi_device_configure 478/478); only literal pools differ.
apollo-main additionally keeps build_dma_cmdlist 0x4bfa3c, mspi_cq_add_transaction 0x4bfcc0 and am_hal_mspi_nonblocking_transfer 0x4c2208, which the bootloader's linker dropped.

Paired callees: CMDQ init/enable/disable/get_status/term/error_resume = 0x538d58/0x538e3c/0x538e8c/0x53901a/0x53909a/0x5390fc, clock manager 0x4c44bc/0x4c4530/0x4c45a4, power domains 0x47f5b8/0x47f7ae, delay 0x4807a0, status check 0x480826. g_MSPIState is 0x200523d8 (bootloader 0x2001caa0); gAmHalCmdq 0x2006ef28.

The earlier note that apollo-main 'contains the post-RTM aperture table' does not apply to its MSPI code: the HAL text is RTM. Its callers (mx25u_mspi_init.c, drv_mx25u25643g.c, fal-norflash) already pass the stock 24-byte RTM dev-config bytes and stock request numbers, which the 5.1.0 copy did not match.

apollo_main_mve.finding: Stock ota_s200_firmware_ota.bin contains no Helium/MVE instructions (0 dlstp/letp/vctp/vldr*/vstr*/vpst in a full-image disassembly). The g2-apollo-main build emitted 155 dlstp/letp loops, 13 vctp, 498 vldrw, 313 vstrw, 173 vldrb and 38 vpst across 258 objects.
apollo_main_mve.cause: clang lowers memcpy/memset and struct copies to MVE tail-predicated loops and q-register moves whenever MVE is available; -fno-vectorize/-fno-slp-vectorize do not stop that (tried: counts unchanged).
apollo_main_mve.change: All 38 apollo-main profiles use -mcpu=cortex-m55+nomve (FPv5 hard-float unchanged: __ARM_FP 0xe, __ARM_PCS_VFP; only __ARM_FEATURE_MVE goes away). Composed object: 0 MVE instructions; 2863/2863 compiled, 0 duplicates, the same 24 unresolved names.
